Description
The P65/81 Shock Test System is a higher performance version of the popular Model 65/81 design. 
The P65/81 Shock Test System is a higher performance version of the popular Model 65/81 design. 
It can be equipped with optional shock pulse programmers to generate a wide range of half sine, trapezoidal and terminal peak sawtooth shock pulses. 
The P65/81 includes a TouchTest Shock 2 Table Top Control Console. 
TTS2 makes shock testing safe and easy. 
TTS2 communicates seamlessly with Test Partner Data Acquisition Systems. 
Features highlights 
• TouchTest Shock 2 Controller for easy and safe operation 
• High strength cast aluminum table design for generating high acceleration shock pulses 
• Acceleration Kit to increase velocity change performance 
• Electric hoist lifting and positioning system enables precise drop repeatability 
• Floating Seismic Base to limit the shock energy that transmits to the floor 
• Full range of applications training programs available 
• Worldwide Customer Service department 
Specification highlights 
TABLE DIMENSIONS: 25.6 x 31.9 in. (65 x 81 cm) 
MAX ACCELERATION: 1000g 
MAX VELOCITY CHANGE: 
• Free Fall: 20 – 25 ft./sec (6.1 – 7.6 m/sec) 
• Accelerated: 25 – 50 ft./sec (7.6 – 15.2 m/sec) 
MAX PAYLOAD: 
• Free Fall: 1500 lbs. (680 kg) 
• Accelerated: 500 lbs. (227 kg) 
Options highlights 
• Low Impulse Kits to extend low level testing capability 
• Dual Mass Shock Amplifiers to generate extremely high acceleration levels (10,000g+) 
• Additional Shock Pulse Programmers for short and long duration half sine, trapezoidal, and terminal peak sawtooth shock pulses 
• Test Partner Data Acquisition and instrumentation for data collection and analysis
